name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! It went much better than usual♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How did it go for you, Treasurer?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hold on!! Why are you getting all gloomy on your own!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine. Both his scholarship and his presidency are completely safe.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That means no expulsion and no stepping down, so we can keep enjoying our sparkling school life together just like before!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I really gotta shape up for the next one...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Next time, I'll help you study with everything I've got♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's nice and all, but make sure you work hard on your own stuff too.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wait, why aren't you asking me, huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's what you'd call reading between the lines, man.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then. Since exams are over and all, shall we go out somewhere after this?」
In the direction Lolotte was waving stood Riesling-san and Amyrina.
The two of them shake their heads.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. Then wanna come over to my place?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, I'm back! Brought some friends over~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh? You've never been to Nana-chan's place before?」

name: Synn
message: 「We've only ever mentioned that her family runs a soba shop, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, when it comes to restaurants, I've only ever explored curry rice or hamburg steak places...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Heehee... you're acting just like a child.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh--!? That is not true at all~~!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You shouldn't be a picky eater, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mgh... those words just now. Please make sure you remember them well.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wanko soba is, you know, soba served in little bowls~」

name: Riesling
message: 「Furthermore, it is a time-honored tradition of hospitality in which the soba is automatically reloaded so the guest's bowl never becomes empty.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... is wanko soba okay? They both seem super interested.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's more reasonably priced than tenzaru, too.」
And so, in the kitchen, Nanaka's old man was boiling soba at a furious pace.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then on your marks, get set, go~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I'm sure I finished it all, yet... why is there soba in my bowl?!」

name: Synn
message: 「As expected of a soba shop's only daughter.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan put soba refills into everyone's bowls with blinding speed~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehehe. I wonder how long you'll be able to keep smiling~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm gonna feed you till you're stuffed to bursting!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You two sure are full of energy~~」
Lolotte and Amyrina eat the soba at a dizzying speed.
Though Nanaka is tossing noodles into their bowls at a brisk pace as well--

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, Daddy hasn't given up on you yet!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We can still eat plenty more. Right, Amyrina?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, you two!! Where is all that food even going in those tiny bodies of yours!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「They have already consumed over a hundred bowls apiece, yet--」

name: Riesling
message: 「To the young mistresses, it is merely an hors d'oeuvre!」

name: Synn
message: 「Please stop drawing your pistol every single time.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*Huff, huff...* No good... I give up...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Still, Lolotte. Food is meant to be chewed slowly and savored, isn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah! R-Right... Which means it's our loss.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Let's go with regular soba instead of wanko soba after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't sweat it, don't sweat it. Nobody ever orders wanko soba here, so it's been a while since I had this much fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「And Nanaka's dad was really going all out too.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Those two both love festivals, after all~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come now. You too, Jiiya, let's eat before the noodles get soggy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah! That's right, Amyrina. How about trying some wasabi in it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I must properly teach her that everyone has likes and dislikes. After all, it is a path I have walked myself!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawa\s01 Um, Mr. Cashier. May we please have some wasabi?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You betcha, one order of freshly grated coming right up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You dissolve this into the dipping sauce before eating, you see.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mmph... Something is shooting right up my nose...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed, indeed. That being said, having likes and dislikes is--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's so crisp and refreshing, and super delicious!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「To think such a wonderful food exists!! Thank you for introducing me to it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Amazing, Amyrina. Even though Rolo-chan can't handle it at all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mghhh. Somehow this makes me so frustrated! I want to find wasabi delicious too!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I don't think you should push yourself~」

name: Synn
message: 「Good food is best eaten however you like it.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Even though it's so delicious... slurp, slurp.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Hasn't the volume of Rolo-chan's mentsuyu increased?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much, Jiiya♪ Now then--」
